record.oneLiner: PitchBook Direct Data / API: a separately contracted add-on that issues API keys or authentication tokens through the Direct Data sales team.
record.verdictReason: Read by hand in a browser. PitchBook runs its own hosted MCP server at premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp: the endpoint answers HTTP 401 without a token and its OAuth metadata names PitchBook's own authorization server, so MCP access uses OAuth and needs an account. The REST API is sales-led (contact form, pay for what you use), so a toolkit is partly buildable but gated. The REST API's own auth method is not stated on public pages (apiKey is a best guess); no pitchbook.com help page describing the MCP was found, so MCP eligibility is unconfirmed.
